channel.title: MassPermits Research
channel.description: Original analysis of Massachusetts building-permit records. Every figure recomputed from the live data, with the method published alongside.

item.title: What 73 Massachusetts towns publish in their permit records
item.description: Every one of the 73 Massachusetts municipal sources behind MassPermits, what each publishes, and what it does not - 51 publish no project value and 8 publish coordinates.

item.title: Methodology - how MassPermits measures Massachusetts permit data
item.description: How MassPermits collects Massachusetts building-permit records, how work is classified, what is deliberately withheld, and the four rules every research page on this site follows.

item.title: Corrections and rejected analyses
item.description: Corrections and rejected analyses. Every figure MassPermits computed, verified and then declined to publish, with the reason it did not survive.

item.title: What permit follows what in Massachusetts, and how long after
item.description: Across 13,732 Massachusetts addresses that filed more than one trade, 12 pairs of trades run reliably one way. A kitchen/bath permit is followed by gas 84% of the time, a median 22 days later.

item.title: Friday is the quietest day in Massachusetts permit records - and in one town it does not exist
item.description: Across 75,939 Massachusetts building permits from 73 municipal sources, Friday accounts for 13.0% of dated records against roughly 22.4% on Tuesday. In Hingham it is zero.

item.title: We found 303 accessory-dwelling-unit permits in Massachusetts records - and the apparent boom is not real
item.description: 303 ADU permits across 32 Massachusetts towns. Raw monthly counts climb from 4 to 63, but normalized against the same sources the rate is flat. 20.1% mention a garage.
